chapter: The Original Dixieland band to California
title: The Original Dixieland Jazz Band name and recruiting Joe and Victor Spencer
summary: Backers Bespawn and Hill used a famous name for their band and sent Toby Mitchell to Louisiana, where he picked up Joe and trumpeter Victor Spencer.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: I was interrupting your story, asking you about the Hot Five. So then you came out to the West Coast, right?

Well, this guy... Like I said, Bespawn(?) and Hill, they called it the Original Dixieland Jazz Band. Now, I didn't know why they wanted to take that name. Because that was a famous name, you know. But they wanted to pick up on a famous name for some reason, for the simple reason that they didn't know what they was doing to start with, organizing the band. So they put this guy Toby Mitchell, give him the bankrolling to come to Louisiana to find some musicians that would go to Houston and rehearse and organize the band, and then we'd play one-nighters up the coast.
But he picked me up pin Baton Rouge, and Victor Spencer, a trumpet player who was playing with the Banner Band -- a left handed trumpet player who was pretty good.
I've heard a lot about him, yeah.
